effect_floor_reason: Inherited from Generation 7. The two-level numerical reference must stay below 1e-10 or the tolerance is frozen again before the census. The floor is not moved because a two-dimensional search is harder, and it is not moved after composed margins are read.
match_tolerance_reason: Same absolute singleton tolerance as Generation 7. Both residual components must lie inside it. The joint distance is an optimiser aid and is not the success test. The tolerance is not loosened after the census.
joint_scale_floor_reason: Each direction's scale is max(|Delta_T|, 1e-8). If both |Delta_T| are below 1e-8, the scale source is the baseline committor, max(|Q0|, 1e-8). Scales are functions of the target only.
unsearched: refitting the condition-erased scalar with two parameters
note: Two-level complementary pair-face control. The higher-order singleton stays the Generation 7 target. The control adds m_off and m_on on one live pair face and does not add a second predicate.
